<?php

const MOD = 1000000007;

function modPow(int $base, int $exponent, int $mod): int
{
    $base %= $mod;
    if ($base < 0) {
        $base += $mod;
    }

    $result = 1;

    while ($exponent > 0) {
        if ($exponent % 2 === 1) {
            $result = ($result * $base) % $mod;
        }

        $base = ($base * $base) % $mod;
        $exponent = intdiv($exponent, 2);
    }

    return $result;
}

function reversed(string $string): string
{
    $characters = preg_split('//u', $string, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
    return implode('', array_reverse($characters));
}

function divCeil(int $number, int $divisor): int
{
    $quotient = intdiv($number, $divisor);

    if ($number % $divisor !== 0) {
        $quotient++;
    }

    return $quotient;
}

function minimum(int ...$numbers): int
{
    $minimum = $numbers[0];

    foreach ($numbers as $number) {
        if ($number < $minimum) {
            $minimum = $number;
        }
    }

    return $minimum;
}

function maximum(int ...$numbers): int
{
    $maximum = $numbers[0];

    foreach ($numbers as $number) {
        if ($number > $maximum) {
            $maximum = $number;
        }
    }

    return $maximum;
}

function absolute(int $number): int
{
    return $number < 0 ? -$number : $number;
}

function isPrime(int $number): bool
{
    if ($number === 2 || $number === 3) {
        return true;
    }

    if ($number <= 1 || $number % 2 === 0 || $number % 3 === 0) {
        return false;
    }

    for ($i = 5; $i * $i <= $number; $i += 6) {
        if ($number % $i === 0 || $number % ($i + 2) === 0) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

function gcd(int $a, int $b): int
{
    while ($b !== 0) {
        [$a, $b] = [$b, $a % $b];
    }

    return $a;
}

function lcm(int $a, int $b): int
{
    return intdiv(absolute($a), gcd($a, $b)) * absolute($b);
}

function digitAt(int $number, int $position): int
{
    if ($number === 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    $number = absolute($number);
    $length = (int) log10($number) + 1;

    if ($position < 0 || $position >= $length) {
        throw new RuntimeException(
            sprintf(
                'Out of bound access for digit. Position passed %d, number %d',
                $position,
                $number
            )
        );
    }

    $power = 10 ** $position;
    $remainder = $number % (10 ** ($position + 1));

    return intdiv($remainder, $power);
}

$index = 0;

$output = [];

while ($t-- > 0) {
    $n = (int) $tokens[$index++];

    $output[] = (string) modPow($n, $k, MOD);
}

echo implode(PHP_EOL, $output);
if ($output !== []) {

}

source_data.prob_desc_description: Baby Badawy's first words were "AND 0 SUM BIG", so he decided to solve the following problem. Given two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$, count the number of arrays of length $$$n$$$ such that:  all its elements are integers between $$$0$$$ and $$$2^k-1$$$ (inclusive);  the bitwise AND of all its elements is $$$0$$$;  the sum of its elements is as large as possible. Since the answer can be very large, print its remainder when divided by $$$10^9+7$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: For each test case, print the number of arrays satisfying the conditions. Since the answer can be very large, print its remainder when divided by $$$10^9+7$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains an integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10$$$) — the number of test cases you need to solve. Each test case consists of a line containing two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^{5}$$$, $$$1 \le k \le 20$$$).
